scaleme.midnightconfig.title: ScaleMe
scaleme.midnightconfig.handDesc: Adjust how your held item looks in your hand
scaleme.midnightconfig.enableHandItemTra: Turns on the custom held item positioning. Disable this to restore the default look and avoid conflicts with other mods.
scaleme.midnightconfig.enableSeparateHan:
Enable Separate Off-Hand Transform 
(Off-Hand sliders at the bottom of the page)
Turns on separate positioning for your off-hand item. When disabled, the off-hand uses the same transform as the main hand. Enable this to customise the settings below.
scaleme.midnightconfig.itemScale.tooltip:
How big or small the item in your hand appears.
Smaller values make it tiny, larger values make it huge.
Shifts the item in your hand to the left or right.
Negative values move it left, positive values move it right.
Shifts the item in your hand up or down.
Negative values move it down, positive values move it up.
Shifts the item in your hand closer to or further from your screen.
Negative values push it away, positive values bring it closer.
scaleme.midnightconfig.itemRotationX.too: Tilts the item in your hand up or down.
scaleme.midnightconfig.itemRotationY.too: Rotates the item in your hand to the left or right.
scaleme.midnightconfig.itemRotationZ.too: Spins the item in your hand clockwise or counterclockwise.
scaleme.midnightconfig.offhandDesc: Off-Hand Item — requires 'Enable Separate Off-Hand Transform' to be ON
How big or small the off-hand item appears.
Only active when 'Enable Separate Off-Hand Transform' is enabled.
scaleme.midnightconfig.itemTranslationXO:
Shifts the off-hand item to the left or right.
Only active when 'Enable Separate Off-Hand Transform' is enabled.
scaleme.midnightconfig.itemTranslationYO:
Shifts the off-hand item up or down.
Only active when 'Enable Separate Off-Hand Transform' is enabled.
scaleme.midnightconfig.itemTranslationZO:
Shifts the off-hand item closer to or further from your screen.
Only active when 'Enable Separate Off-Hand Transform' is enabled.
scaleme.midnightconfig.itemRotationXOffh:
Tilts the off-hand item up or down.
Only active when 'Enable Separate Off-Hand Transform' is enabled.
scaleme.midnightconfig.itemRotationYOffh:
Rotates the off-hand item to the left or right.
Only active when 'Enable Separate Off-Hand Transform' is enabled.
scaleme.midnightconfig.itemRotationZOffh:
Spins the off-hand item clockwise or counterclockwise.
Only active when 'Enable Separate Off-Hand Transform' is enabled.
scaleme.midnightconfig.animDesc: Adjust how your held item animates
scaleme.midnightconfig.enableAnimOverrid: Turns on the custom animation settings below. Disable this to keep the default Minecraft swing animations.
scaleme.midnightconfig.disableSwingBobbi: Prevents the item from bouncing up and down when you swing it.
scaleme.midnightconfig.ignoreSwingSpeedE: Potion effects like Haste or Mining Fatigue will no longer change how fast your arm swings.
scaleme.midnightconfig.swingAnimationSpe:
How fast your arm swings when you attack or use an item.
Lower values slow it down, higher values speed it up.
scaleme.midnightconfig.disableSwingAnima: Completely removes the arm swing animation. Your arm stays still when you click.
scaleme.midnightconfig.enableSwingOverri: Turns on the custom swing arc and drift sliders below. Disable this to keep the default Minecraft swing shape.
scaleme.midnightconfig.swingArmXScale.to:
Controls how much the item moves left/right during a swing.
Set to 0 to stop the item lunging toward the center of the screen.
scaleme.midnightconfig.swingArmYScale.to:
Controls how much the item bobs up and down during a swing.
Set to 0 to remove the vertical movement entirely.
scaleme.midnightconfig.swingArmZScale.to:
Controls how much the item pushes forward during a swing.
Set to 0 to stop the item launching toward the screen.
scaleme.midnightconfig.swingArmXMultiply: Mirror Drift X for Left Hand

When enabled, the X drift is flipped for your off-hand so it mirrors the main hand.
This matches vanilla behaviour. Disable for a symmetric drift on both hands.
scaleme.midnightconfig.swingPreRotationY:
The starting Y angle the item is rotated to before the swing arc begins.
45° matches vanilla. Lower values keep the item more face-on during the swing.
scaleme.midnightconfig.swingArcYAmount.t:
How many degrees the item rotates around Y during the swing.
Negative values rotate it to the left, positive to the right.
scaleme.midnightconfig.swingArcZAmount.t:
How many degrees the item tilts sideways during the swing.
Negative values tilt it one way, positive the other.
scaleme.midnightconfig.swingArcXAmount.t:
How many degrees the item swings downward during an attack.
This is the main downward chop. Set closer to 0 to reduce the downward arc.
scaleme.midnightconfig.swingCounterRotat:
When enabled, the pre-rotation is undone at the end of the arc, which swings the item toward the center of the screen.
Disable this to keep the item at its held position during the swing, similar to 1.8.9.
scaleme.midnightconfig.scaleDesc: Adjust the size of players and entities in the world
scaleme.midnightconfig.scaleNameTags: Let name tags follow the player's scale
scaleme.midnightconfig.scaleNameTags.too:
Makes name tags follow the player's scale instead of being fixed at 1.0x.
This only affects players and entities that have their own name tag.
scaleme.midnightconfig.playerScale.toolt:
Changes how big or small your own character appears to others.
Does not affect your own first-person view.
scaleme.midnightconfig.otherPlayersScale: Changes how big or small other players appear to you.
Changes how big or small villagers NPC in Hypixel appear.
scaleme.midnightconfig.hypixelNpcScale.t:
Changes how big or small Hypixel NPCs appear.
Only has an effect when playing on Hypixel.
scaleme.midnightconfig.viewDescription: Control your crosshair and camera behaviour
scaleme.midnightconfig.enableCrosshairIn: Shows the crosshair when the camera is behind your character.
Shows the crosshair when the camera is facing your character from the front.
Removes the option to flip the camera to face your character.
scaleme.midnightconfig.showOwnNametagInT: Show Own Nametag in Third Person
Shows your own nametag when you are in third person.
